responsibility: Central C header for GNAT exception-runtime support. It defines the C representation of Exception_Data and Exception_Id, declares memory and initialization hooks used by the runtime, exposes handler-installation/context-adjustment entry points, and provides the shared interface consumed by init.c, seh_init.c, raise-gcc.c, and related exception/termination code.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface/definition header in the raise pair: it defines the C layout of Exception_Data and Exception_Id and declares shared exception-runtime entry points such as __gnat_unhandled_terminate, initialization hooks, handler installation, and context adjustment. Unlike gcc/ada/raise.c, it is the common ABI and declaration surface for exception support, not the file that implements the default termination routine.
